theme: An open Sunday with a long road in it.

needsAttention.title: The Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your one p1, a month past its date. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — thin inventory, holiday pricing, and it sells out. A refundable hold costs nothing and takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 15 booking date has passed. Six people over three weeks across the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year; the open question is still domestic-and-done versus refundable-international.

needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani sent the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs job description and is waiting to hear whether it's worth exploring. It's sat since Wednesday.
